# Andrew Gillfillan

> Andrew Gillfillan is a newsroom executive and content and editorial product builder based in East Lansing, Michigan. He turns audience needs and complicated subjects into durable shows, streams, newsletters, election products, public-record tools and the operating systems that sustain them.

Canonical site: https://www.andrewgillfillan.com/
Preferred name: Andrew Gillfillan
Also known as: Andy Gillfillan; Andrew J. Gillfillan
Current role: News Director, WKAR at Michigan State University
Location: East Lansing, Michigan, United States
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/andrewjgillfillan
Contact: andrew@andrewgillfillan.com

## Professional positioning

- Newsroom executive
- Content and editorial product builder
- Content strategy and multiplatform distribution leader
- Audience development and digital growth leader
- Newsroom transformation, talent development and editorial operations
- Newsletter, streaming, election, breaking-news and public-record products

Andrew is about more than publishing news. He builds content people want to see, gives teams and their expertise a visible identity, chooses the right platform and release sequence, creates audience conversation and turns successful ideas into formats and workflows that can last for years.

## Selected work

- [Editorial product portfolio](https://www.andrewgillfillan.com/work.html): seven documented case studies.
- [The Sunday Signal and Signal+](https://www.andrewgillfillan.com/the-signal.html): audience need, product concept, newsletter architecture, newsroom workflow and original-send performance. Sunday Signal launched February 1, 2026; Signal+ launched July 29, 2026. Resends are excluded from published performance counts.
- [Election 2026](https://www.andrewgillfillan.com/election-2026.html): dedicated election destination, service tools, content architecture and local politics coverage.
- [eightWest](https://www.andrewgillfillan.com/eightwest.html): a commercial daily lifestyle and entertainment show Andrew conceived and built at WOOD TV8; launched October 5, 2009 and still on the air.
- [Digital audience growth](https://www.andrewgillfillan.com/audience-growth.html): analytics-led platform, timing and distribution strategy at WKAR.
- [Newsroom leadership](https://www.andrewgillfillan.com/newsroom.html): hiring, coaching, visible talent, capacity and editorial ownership.
- [Independent Product Lab](https://www.andrewgillfillan.com/data-ai-systems.html): the Michigan Data Center Tracker and private, evidence-first reporting systems built independently on nights and weekends, entirely outside WKAR and Michigan State University.
- [CBS News Miami stream and Headliners](https://www.andrewgillfillan.com/miami-stream.html): launch leadership for the 24-hour CBS News Miami stream and the Headliners weekly stream program.

## Career

[Career history](https://www.andrewgillfillan.com/career.html) covers more than two decades across nine newsrooms: WKAR at Michigan State University, CBS News Miami, NBC Bay Area, FOX 26 Houston, FOX 17 WXMI, WDIV Local 4 Detroit, WISH-TV Indianapolis, WOOD TV8 Grand Rapids and WLNS Lansing.

## Editorial and product principles

[Andrew's point of view](https://www.andrewgillfillan.com/point-of-view.html) emphasizes compelling content, real voices, depth, deliberate distribution, trust, talent development and audience conversation. AI is a bounded tool inside a human-led system, not an editorial authority.

## Source and confidentiality note

The portfolio uses authentic work samples and documented career information. Confidential independent work is described without naming or exposing private employers, products, sources, screenshots or proprietary details.
